title: Sulfur Boots
description: Makes Sulfur Cubes WEARABLE! Silly little addition. NO RESOURCEPACK.
body:
Whenever you bucket up Sulfur Cubes, they can be worn like boots! The soft sulfuric body just slurps up your feet and make you bouncy! While worn you can fall further without getting hurt and bounce off the floor just fine!

Inspired by Jake the Dog. Made in 2 minutes. Have fun!
